title: LEVEL Trial: Correction of Inguinal Hernia, Endoscopic Versus Lichtenstein
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to compare laparoscopic total extraperitoneal and open mesh repair of inguinal hernia, with regard to hospital stay, postoperative pain, quality of life, postoperative recovery and return to daily activities, complications and recurrences
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* informed consent
* age \> 18 years
* inguinal hernia(primary, recurrence or bilateral)
* elective procedure

Exclusion Criteria:

* Scrotal hernia
* Prostatectomy, Pfannenstiehl-incision, pre-peritoneal surgery in history
* Participation in other trial
* Pregnancy
* Communicative or cognitive restrictions
